wordle.title: Word of the day
wordle.description: Guess the hidden word in {{max}} tries or fewer. The final word is related to Catholicism and can be a proper noun. Each word has {{length}} letters. After each attempt, the colors show whether a letter is in the right place (green), elsewhere in the word (yellow) or not in the word (gray).

guessCard.title: Guess the card
guessCard.description: A saint's card is zoomed in a lot: guess who it is in {{guesses}} tries or fewer. Each mistake zooms the card out and costs 5 XP. Level 1: zoom. Level 2: the card is also grayscale. Level 3: it is also rotated.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Find the {{pairs}} pairs of cards. They come from the same family or are linked to each other. The fewer moves you make, the more XP you earn; in case of a tie, the fastest player ranks higher.

steps.welcome: Peace be with you! I'm Saint Peter, keeper of the keys. Let me show you around.
steps.collection: This is your collection: every card you've obtained.
steps.packs: Open packs to discover new cards.
steps.shop: Stop by the shop to grow your collection.
steps.friends: Add friends to share the adventure.
steps.minigames: And to unwind, mini-games are waiting for you here.
steps.outro: That's everything! Safe travels, and may luck be with you.
